notes:
Independently inventoried the repo's full surface and compared it to recon.json. Recon enumerates 53 items: 8 components, 6 data stores, 26 entry points, 7 trust boundaries, 6 external deps. Every major subsystem is present and correctly attributed.

Components: all 8 docker-compose services are captured (identity, community, workshop, chatbot, MCP server :5500, web/nginx, gateway/api.mypremiumdealership.com, mailhog) plus postgres/mongo/chroma as data stores. No service is missing.

Routes cross-checked against real route tables:
- identity (services/identity/.../controller/*): all 8 controllers' mappings reviewed; headline vuln endpoints (login/signup/verify with alg-confusion/jku, v2/v3 check-otp, login-with-token, vehicle location BOLA, convert_video shell injection, admin video delete BFLA, permitAll dashboard, management apikey) are in recon (E1-E10).
- community (api/router/routes.go): all routes (posts recent/search/by-id/create/comment, coupon new/validate, home) captured by E11-E13.
- workshop (crapi/*/urls.py): mechanic/merchant/shop/management views captured by E14-E20 (SSRF, unauth BOLA on service_requests & orders, SQLi apply_coupon, mechanic self-signup, admin users/all).
- chatbot (app.py -> /chatbot/genai/* blueprint; langgraph_agent.py SQLDatabaseToolkit + terminal/code tools + MCP tools) captured by E21-E23, C5/C6, TB6.
- gateway (main.go: /v1/vin/ownership, /v1/payment with hardcoded BasicAuth, SSN/card data) captured by E25.
- nginx proxies, /debug autoindex, /mailhog proxy, access-log-in-webroot captured by E24/E26/D6/TB1/TB2.

Minor entry points NOT individually listed (none rise to a missed major subsystem; all belong to subsystems recon already covers, and the risk-bearing endpoint of each subsystem is present):
- Django admin panel (path "workshop/admin/", services/workshop/crapi_site/urls.py + crapi/admin.py registering Order/User/Product/AppliedCoupon/Mechanic/ServiceRequest/UserDetails/Vehicle) and workshop/health_check/ — standard auth-gated Django admin, not a custom vulnerable surface; the workshop subsystem itself is thoroughly enumerated.
- identity profile uploads /api/v2/user/pictures and /api/v2/user/videos (the convert_video shell-injection sink is already E7); forget-password/reset-password, change-email/verify-email-token, change-phone-number/verify-phone-otp, unlock, reset-test-users, v3/check-otp, /api/auth/jwks.json — all part of C2 identity, with the headline OTP/email-token/JWT issues captured at E3/E4/E5.
- community /debug/pprof/ (only mounted when DEBUG=1) and gateway HelloServer root banner — trivial.
- nginx /.well-known/jwks.json proxy — the JWKS/jku/alg-confusion attack surface is already represented in E3.

Conclusion: recon misses no major subsystem; every service, data store, trust boundary, and external dependency in the repo is represented, and the vulnerability-bearing endpoint for each subsystem is present. The coverage denominator is trustworthy for this run. (independent_surface_count set equal to recon's 53 because my independent inventory yields the same set of major surface items; the additional endpoints I found are minor variants within already-counted subsystems, not new major surface.)
